reviews.text: I brought my puppy here for the first time and I am very happy with the result! 🐶❤️ It is obvious that they really take care of the dogs here with love and great attention. They were very kind and attentive to us. We will definitely come back! 🥰

I've been taking my dog ​​to Teri's for almost two years, since the first time, and I haven't regretted it for a moment 🥰
She always welcomes us with great love, patience and attention. Modjo loves going to her, when we turn into the street, he almost jumps out of his skin with joy 😄
The most important thing for me is to be able to entrust my dog ​​to her with peace of mind, and I always feel this with Teri. You can see that she does her job with all her heart and soul, and it shows every time. I can only recommend her! ❤️
Professional, very kind, Diána treated the dog firmly but patiently. Thank you very much, we will go again. 😊 …
Teri took care of my puppy's teeth very professionally. This ultrasonic tartar removal without anesthesia is amazing, I recommend it to everyone. Thank you very much Teri ❤️

We tried to make an appointment at Dogmopolite several times - submitted requests through the website, but no one ever got back to us. Eventually, we started calling the listed phone numbers ourselves, but no one answered.

Teresa is the best!
Big hug and everything!
Teri is very kind, knowledgeable and helpful, I can only recommend her to everyone!
They are super nice, super precise!

Wonderful place. Always receive a friendly service from this place, and always easy to arrange and get things done, the way it needs to be done. Tessa is always helpful in a variety of manners to resolve a problem.

The people working here clearly couldn’t care less about potential clients :) We’ve communicated a few times — the first time, due to their carelessness, we were scheduled for the wrong date, so we had to cancel. The second time, they told us there were no available slots until the end of the year and didn’t even offer any alternatives. I believe the time spent writing this review is more worthwhile than dealing with these staff members. I do not recommend them.
She’s really a professional. Good with my dog and always easy to communicate🩵 You can make an appointment with text in english. Thank you! …

Thank you very much, dear Teri, for the fantastic job you did today! Finally, an honest person who gave a negative and positive opinion, which was of course constructive! And what was most important to us was her kindness! We can't get enough of her, our little dog has become so beautiful! Thank you again🙏 …
Tücsi and Lilu are a mother and daughter duo. They are very shy but they love Teca. I can only recommend them.

Dear Radwan,

Thank you very much for taking the time and rating our business, however, in this case, we do not see any booking or actual service provided under this name in our system. Should you be our client, we kindly ask you to elaborate a bit on the review to examine your complaint asap.

Thank you ever so much,

Kind regards,

Peter Gárdos
General Manager

Very modern salon and very friendly atmosphere
We would like to thank Teri for her professional work.
Sanyi dog.🐩 …

They were very kind and professional, they paid attention to every detail!! My dog ​​not only looked beautiful, but he also seemed to be having a good time. The staff was attentive and friendly, and I was able to book an appointment easily. I definitely recommend them to anyone who wants quality and loving care for their pet! <33
